item.title: Rapper Ghetts jailed over fatal hit-and-run
item.description: Award-winning rapper Ghetts has been jailed for 12 years for killing a student in a hit-and-run collision in north-east London. The 41-year-old, whose real name is Justin Clarke-Samuel, was sentenced at the Old Bailey after he previously admitted causing the death of 20-year-old Yubin Tamang by dangerous driving. item.title: GRA seizes 146.9 million tramadol tablets at Tema Port
item.description: The Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) has intercepted a massive shipment of undeclared tramadol at Tema Port in an intelligence-led operation. The seized container (No. TGHU6228715), originating from the United Arab Emirates, contained 299 cartons with 146,932,000 tablets (250mg and 225mg) of tramadol hydrochloride, weighing 34,847.2 kilograms.
